instruction: A candid family photograph in a medium-full shot captures a playful morning scene. In a cozy bedroom with patterned wallpaper and a white bed, the bearded man in a white t-shirt (R1) planks on a woven rug, laughing heartily towards the camera. The woman in a white button-up shirt (R3) sits on his lower back, smiling warmly. She holds the toddler in striped pajamas (R2) steady as the child stands upright on the man's back. Soft, natural indoor light fills the room, creating a warm and cheerful atmosphere.
